description: Free-tier reference math. Returns the PrizePicks Power Play (all legs must hit) and Flex Play (partial payouts) entry payout schedule for 2-6 legs, plus the per-leg breakeven win probability for each play. Pass leg_win_prob (e.g. 0.58) to also get expected_return (per $1) and is_plus_ev per play — the slip-level breakeven. Useful for: 'what hit rate do I need to beat a 4-pick PrizePicks Power play', 'is a 3-leg flex +EV at 60% per leg'. NOTE: standard published payouts only — demon/goblin per-pick modifiers aren't in PrizePicks's feed (see the disclaimer field); breakeven assumes independent legs.

leg_win_prob.description: Optional assumed per-leg win probability in [0,1]. Adds expected_return + is_plus_ev to each play.
